'''Atomic buffalo turds''' (also known as '''ABTs''') are a variation of the jalapeño popper.

== Ingredients ==
*[[Cookbook:Jalapeño|Jalapeño]] peppers
*[[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|Cream cheese]]
*Cocktail [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
*[[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]] slices

== Procedure ==

# Halve the jalapeño peppers lengthwise and scrape out membrane and seeds.
# Fill the peppers with cream cheese, and then place a cocktail sausage on top of the cream cheese.
# Cut the bacon slices in half, and wrap each halved pepper in bacon. A cocktail stick or [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] can be used to hold the ABTs together if needed.
# Cook the ABTs by barbecuing, [[Cookbook:Baking|baking]], or [[Cookbook:Grilling|grilling]]. They are done when the bacon is crisped and the jalapeño has softened but not to the point of collapsing. When oven-baked or indirectly grilled, they are typically cooked at approximately 275°F (135°C) for 2 hours, or until bacon is crisped.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Try using [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]] or other cheese in place of the cream cheese.
* If the heat of the jalapeño peppers does not appeal, [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]] may be used instead—quarter the bell peppers and scrape out the seeds before filling.
* The ABTs can be [[Cookbook:Basting|basted]] with a [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]] before being cooked.
